note: The DocAble code-inspection experiment motivates examining the machinery needed for informed engineering control. The first subsection introduces the foundation model and harness, retaining the concrete distinction between a harness hook and an installed environment check. Reasoning horizons and probabilistic work then prepare the representation and enforcement problems in §1.5.
